description: Defines the FileStorage class implementing PhpStorageInterface for storing PHP code as files, managing directories, and file operations within Drupal.

classes.name: FileStorage
classes.description: Implements file-based PHP code storage with directory management and cleanup functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes FileStorage with configuration specifying storage directory and bin.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a file with the given name exists.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads PHP code from a file, including it if it exists.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves PHP code to a specified file, creating directories as needed.

methods.name: ensureDirectory
methods.description: Ensures a directory exists, has correct permissions, and contains a .htaccess file.

methods.name: createDirectory
methods.description: Recursively creates directories with specified permissions.

methods.name: getFullPath
methods.description: Returns the full path for a given filename.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all files in the storage directory.

methods.name: listAll
methods.description: Lists all stored file names excluding .htaccess.

methods.name: garbageCollection
methods.description: Placeholder for cleanup operations, currently empty.
